Crucially, it lacks a mandatory human review step before outreach and fails to include a voluntary self-declaration mechanism that allows students to define their own needs without being flagged first. Without these safeguards, this system will inevitably alienate the very vulnerable students it aims to help by replacing trust with invasive monitoring.
